# SharePoint Embedded — Agent Docs

> Agent-first documentation for SharePoint Embedded (SPE), converted from the official
> Microsoft Learn docs (SharePoint/sp-dev-docs). Hand this file and the linked .md pages
> to an AI agent so it can perform SPE tasks against Microsoft Graph and Microsoft Purview.
> Each page is self-contained: prerequisites, exact API calls, persona (developer/admin),
> and a source_of_truth link back to Microsoft Learn.

## Overview & scenarios
- [SharePoint Embedded Overview](overview.md): Microsoft SharePoint Embedded is a cloud-based file and document management system suitable for use in any application. SharePoint Embedded is a new API-only solution that enables app developers to harness the power of the Microsoft 365 file and document storage platform for any app, and is suitable for enterprises building line-of-business applications and ISVs building multitenant applications.
- [Scenarios and Use Cases](scenarios-and-use-cases.md): Scenarios and Use Cases for SharePoint Embedded
- [What's new in SharePoint Embedded?](whats-new.md): Updates about Microsoft SharePoint Embedded.

## Get started
- [Create new SharePoint Embedded container types](getting-started__containertypes.md): This article explains how container types work and the steps to create new container types. (scenarios: A2)

- [SharePoint Embedded for Visual Studio Code](getting-started__spembedded-for-vscode.md): Installation and getting started with SharePoint Embedded for Visual Studio Code (scenarios: D2)

## Graph API reference (beta) — exact calls for Core Storage
- [driveItem: createUploadSession](graph-api/driveitem-createuploadsession.md): Create an upload session to allow your app to upload files up to the maximum file size. (scenarios: D3)
- [Create a new folder](graph-api/driveitem-post-children.md): Create a new folder or DriveItem in a Drive with a specified parent item or path. (scenarios: D3)
- [Upload small files](graph-api/driveitem-put-content.md): Provide the contents of a new file or update the contents of an existing file in a single API call. (scenarios: D3)
- [Delete permissions](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-delete-permissions.md): Delete permissions from a fileStorageContainer object. (scenarios: D7)
- [Get fileStorageContainer](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-get.md): Retrieve the properties of a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D2)
- [Get column](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-get-column.md): Get the properties of a column represented as a columnDefinition in a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D4)
- [Get drive for fileStorageContainer](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-get-drive.md): Get the properties of a drive associated with a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D3)
- [Get fileStorageContainer permission](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-get-permissions.md): Get a specific permission from a fileStorageContainer object. (scenarios: D7)
- [List columns](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-list-columns.md): Get the collection of columns represented as columnDefinition resources in a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D4)
- [List fileStorageContainer custom properties](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-list-customproperty.md): List the custom properties of a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D4)
- [List fileStorageContainer permissions](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-list-permissions.md): Get the set of permissions for a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D7)
- [List recycleBinItem](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-list-recyclebinitem.md): Get a list of recyclebinitem objects from a fileStorageContainer recycleBin. (scenarios: D5)
- [Upsert permissions](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-patch-permissions.md): Upsert (create or update) up to 40 permissions on a fileStorageContainer in a single request. (scenarios: D7)
- [Create fileStorageContainer](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-post.md): Create a new fileStorageContainer object. (scenarios: D2)
- [Create column](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-post-columns.md): Create a column for a fileStorageContainer that specifies a columnDefinition. (scenarios: D4)
- [Add custom properties to a fileStorageContainer](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-post-customproperty.md): Add custom properties to a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D4)
- [Create permission](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-post-permissions.md): Add a permission to an existing fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D7)
- [Restore recycleBinItem](graph-api/filestoragecontainer-restore-recyclebinitem.md): Restore recycleBinItem to a fileStorageContainer. (scenarios: D5)
